## Checklist

- [ ] Parser change? → fixtures added/updated in `packages/parsers/fixtures/` (anonymized) and `SUPPORTED_VERSIONS.md` updated
- [ ] Scope/architecture/privacy/licensing/money-handling change? → new entry appended to `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] Conventional commit message(s)
- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint` green locally
- [ ] No new dependency without an OSI-approved license; zero React Native in `core`/`parsers`/`cli`
